_: THE DIRECTED LINK TABLE for the cross-continent planner (PlanCross, the app's own MultiHop): every way from one place to another that is not a walk inside one map. The boats, zeppelins and airships come from transports.json (each ride both ways, a hostile town's dock never boarded: TransportRoutes.Ride.hostileDock); the flights from its masters and paths (the faction's own); the rest are listed here with their evidence (E:/safepath-work/docs/ZONE_INVENTORY.md section 2). A link's end with no position (xy null) is a manual link nobody has measured: the planner may take it, at UNKNOWN_YD, and says so. A link that isn't placed in the world is left out. Places: a walk inside one uiMap is taken as open, so a part of a map no one walks to or from (a floating city, the foot of a tree) is a place of its own, found by the AreaTable name of the ground there or by a box.
